query: How many times larger is Russia than France?
answer: By land area, Russia is about 31 times larger than mainland France. That's because Russia covers about 17,098,246 km² within its internationally recognised borders [1], while metropolitan France (the European part) is about 551,695 km² [2][3]. If you count France's overseas regions as well, its total area is about 643,801 km² [3], and Russia comes out about 26–27 times larger. Most people mean European France when they ask this, so "about 30 times larger" is a fair rule of thumb.
